- Monzo 与加密｜Monzo Help（2026-10-24 查阅）：可使用多家长所认可的加密货币交易所；另有滚动 ==30== 日 ==£5,000== 加密支付额度，超限支付不过；公开页写的是法币往来交易所，不是链上收币 https://monzo.com/help/payments-getting-started/monzo-crypto-friendly https://monzo.com/help/payments-getting-started/cryptocurrency-allowance
- Zopa 屏蔽加密交易｜Zopa Help（约 1 个月前更新，2026-10-24 查阅）：We block payments we identify as cryptocurrency transactions；向加密交易所的银行转账或卡支付会被拒 https://www.zopa.com/help/article/what-transaction-limits-apply-to-my-account
- Monzo 美元户 Wire ==$5.99==｜Monzo Community / DepositScout（2026-09–10 用户报，2026-10-24 查阅）：美元账户多为 wire；社区写收/发常见 ==USD 5.99==，中间行或另加费；公开帮助页未单独写 ACH https://community.monzo.com/t/uk-account-numbers-for-currency-accounts/198122 https://depositscout.com/guides/monzo-usd-eur-currency-accounts
